reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The project consists of a senior secured limited recourse project finane loan of up to EUR 22 million in favor of KC Solar2 OÜ (the "Borrower"), a special purpose vehicle incorporated in Estonia established to develop, construct and operate a portfolio of two solar PV power plants with a total capacity of 52.5MW located near Tallinn (the "Project"), in Estonia. The Project portfolio is split in two phases, 7.5 MW capacity ("Phase 1") and 45 MW capacity ("Phase 2"). Each of Phase 1 and 2 of the Project are developed separately, having separate grid connection points and accordingly exporting power independently to the grid. The Bank's loan will finance the development, construction and operation of the 45 MW Phase 2 of the Project. The EBRD loan is approved under EBRD InvestEU Framework for Sustainable Transition and is split in two tranches: EUR 17.5 million tranche, covered by the InvestEU guarantee, and EUR 4.5 million uncovered tranche. The split between the covered and uncovered parts is envisaged to meet the InvestEU criterion according to which up to a maximum of 50% of the total Project cost can be guaranteed by InvestEU programme.
